steam.gameStarted.description: Runs when you start a game on Steam. Streaming tools from Steam, like VTube Studio or VBridger, never count: they are on the Game categories page's list of apps that are never a game. Turn on "Watch Steam for games" on that page first.

fields.game: Only this game, written as Steam names it, like Helldivers 2. Leave it empty to react to every game.

variables.game: The game's name as Steam shows it
variables.steamAppId: The game's number in the Steam store (0 when you tried it with Ask now)
variables.source: Where Cuebot saw the game: steam, or test when you used Ask now

steam.gameStopped.description: Runs when the game you were playing on Steam closes, or another game takes its place. A game that is gone for only a few seconds, like a quick restart, does not count.

fields.game: Only this game, written as Steam names it. Leave it empty to react to every game.

variables.game: The game's name as Steam shows it
variables.steamAppId: The game's number in the Steam store
variables.source: Where Cuebot saw the game: steam

requests.decided.description: Runs when someone answers one of Cuebot's requests, like switching the stream category to the game you play. You, a mod on the mod portal or the companion app can answer.

variables.title: The question, like "Switch the stream category to Helldivers 2?"
variables.detail: What it would change, like "Twitch: Helldivers 2 · Kick: Helldivers 2"
variables.kind: What kind of request it was: category
variables.by: Who answered, like "You (desktop)" or a mod's name
variables.message: What Cuebot says happened, like "Category switched on Twitch (Helldivers 2)."
